name: Redline: Update Existing Element Parameter
description: Apply a redline-requested parameter value to an exact existing Revit element, verify readback, capture focused visual evidence, then revert the parameter to the original value.
setup_instructions: Open the known Revit demo model.
Use a verified existing element id, writable parameter name, requested value, and focused visual view id.
success_criteria: The target id and current value are captured before any write.
The parameter write runs through dry-run and apply passes.
The requested parameter value is verified by readback after commit.
A focused post-change visual capture is returned from the requested view before revert.
The original parameter value is restored with dry-run, apply, and readback evidence.
A redline_update_parameter_summary.json artifact records visual and revert evidence for live promotion review.
failure_criteria: The exact existing element id, parameter name, requested value, or focused view id is missing.
The parameter is read-only, missing, or does not read back the requested value.
The focused capture is missing, from the wrong view, or reported as low quality.
The revert is requested but final readback does not match the captured original value.
optional_cleanup_steps: Always restore the captured original parameter value after verification.
